label: GO after a rewarded trial when the agent picks a2 (mostly switching from a1, or early in the episode)
explanation: Fires only at GO and only when the previous trial was rewarded (100% of activations have prev_reward==1; never at D1/D2, never after no reward). Within that, it is selective for the agent choosing a2 (model_act==2 carries 84% of mass). The strongest activations are switches from a1 to a2 after a rewarded a1 trial, typically a rare a1->S2 rewarded trial (model-based switch), and especially when the trial before was also rewarded (adding tv(prev_reward,-1)==1 raises precision to 0.72 at lower recall). A second, weaker component is a2 choices after reward early in the episode (ep_trial < 10; rate 7-11x in the first trials), including repeated a2 stays at low magnitude. Uses only observed inputs and the agent own policy argmax (no future variables). Not explained: low-magnitude a2 stays after reward later in the episode, and many rewarded a1->a2 switches where the trial before was unrewarded stay silent. Dev F1 0.59, mass recall 0.68.
